completedTasksDetails.name: Setup Project Configuration
completedTasksDetails.description: Generate all configuration files: package.json (with React 18+, TypeScript 5+, Vite, Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, Autoprefixer, and all type definitions), tsconfig.json (strict mode, JSX transform), tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts (React plugin), tailwind.config.js (content paths), postcss.config.js (Tailwind + Autoprefixer), .gitignore (node_modules, dist, IDE files), and index.html (root HTML with script tag for main.tsx)
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Config files need syntax validation before code generation

completedTasksDetails.name: Create Type Definitions
completedTasksDetails.description: Create src/types/task.ts with Task interface (id: string, title: string, completed: boolean, createdAt: Date) and FilterType ('all' | 'completed' | 'active'). This provides centralized type definitions for the entire application.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Single type file, will validate with application code

completedTasksDetails.name: Create Application Entry Points
completedTasksDetails.description: Create src/main.tsx (React root render with StrictMode) and src/index.css (Tailwind directives: @tailwind base, components, utilities, plus any global CSS variables). These bootstrap the React application.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Entry files, will validate with full application

completedTasksDetails.name: Create TaskItem Component
completedTasksDetails.description: Implement src/components/TaskItem.tsx - displays individual task with checkbox for toggling completion, delete button, task title with strikethrough styling when completed. Props: task (Task), onToggle (id => void), onDelete (id => void). Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

completedTasksDetails.name: Create TaskList Component
completedTasksDetails.description: Implement src/components/TaskList.tsx - container that maps tasks array to TaskItem components. Shows empty state message when no tasks. Props: tasks (Task[]), onToggleTask (id => void), onDeleteTask (id => void). Use Tailwind CSS for layout.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

completedTasksDetails.name: Create TaskInput Component
completedTasksDetails.description: Implement src/components/TaskInput.tsx - input form for creating new tasks. Local state for input value, validates non-empty input, clears after submission, handles Enter key. Props: onAddTask (title => void). Use Tailwind CSS for form styling.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

completedTasksDetails.name: Create TaskFilter Component
completedTasksDetails.description: Implement src/components/TaskFilter.tsx - three filter buttons (All, Active, Completed). Highlights active filter, triggers filter changes. Props: currentFilter (FilterType), onFilterChange (filter => void). Use Tailwind CSS for button styling and active state.
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all components

completedTasksDetails.name: Implement App Component with State Management
completedTasksDetails.description: Implement src/App.tsx - root component managing tasks state (Task[]) and filter state (FilterType). Implement addTask (creates task with crypto.randomUUID() or Date.now(), adds to array), toggleTask (finds by id, toggles completed), deleteTask (filters out by id), setFilter (updates filter). Compute filtered tasks based on filter value. Render TaskInput, TaskFilter, and TaskList with proper props. Use Tailwind CSS for layout (responsive, clean design).
completedTasksDetails.validationRationale: Core application logic complete - full validation before final verification

Check for missing features, incomplete implementations, or gaps in functionality.

state.planText:
=== THINKING === **Primary Task:** Complete the Simple Tasks application code to achieve the goals specified in the PRD and Design Document. This is a NEW PROJECT initialization task. **Context Understanding:** - This is a NEW PROJECT with no existing codebase (empty project) - DIRECTIVE: "기획서와 디자인문서의 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 코드를 완성시켜라" (Complete the code to achieve the goals in the PRD and Design Document) - DESIGN DOCUMENT specifies: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS - Technology Stack from Design: - React 18.x - TypeScript 5.x - Vite (build tool) - Tailwind CSS (styling) - No external state management (useState only) - Requirements from PRD: 1. Task creation with non-empty validation 2. Task toggle completion 3. Task deletion 4. Filter by All/Active/Completed 5. Responsive Tailwind UI 6. TypeScript strict typing (no 'any') 7. Keyboard navigation support **Execution Plan:** **PHASE 1: Project Setup (Configuration Files)** 1. **Generate package.json** - Add dependencies: react@^18.2.0, react-dom@^18.2.0 - Add devDependencies: typescript@^5.0.0, vite@^5.0.0, @vitejs/plugin-react@^4.2.0 - Add Tailwind: tailwindcss@^3.4.0, postcss@^8.4.0, autoprefixer@^10.4.0 - Add type definitions: @types/react@^18.2.0, @types/react-dom@^18.2.0 - Scripts: dev, build, preview, lint 2. **Generate tsconfig.json** - Strict mode enabled (no 'any' allowed) - Target: ES2020 - Module: ESNext - JSX: react-jsx - Path aliases: @/* → ./src/* 3. **Generate vite.config.ts** - React plugin configuration - Path alias resolution (@/ → /src) - Build output configuration 4. **Generate Tailwind configuration** - tailwind.config.js: content paths, theme customization - postcss.config.js: tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins 5. **Generate index.html** - Entry point with
- Script tag: - Basic meta tags 6. **Generate .gitignore** - node_modules, dist, .env files 7. **Generate README.md** - Project description, setup instructions, available scripts **PHASE 2: Application Code** 8. **Generate src/main.tsx** - React root rendering - Import global CSS 9. **Generate src/App.tsx** - Main application component - State management for tasks and filter - Integrate TaskInput, TaskFilter, TaskList components 10. **Generate src/index.css** - Tailwind directives (@tailwind base, components, utilities) - Global styles 11. **Generate src/types/task.ts** - Task interface definition - Filter type definition 12. **Generate src/components/TaskInput.tsx** - Input field for new tasks - Non-empty validation - Keyboard support (Enter to submit) 13. **Generate src/components/TaskFilter.tsx** - Filter buttons: All, Active, Completed - Active state styling 14. **Generate src/components/TaskList.tsx** - Render filtered task list - Pass tasks to TaskItem components 15. **Generate src/components/TaskItem.tsx** - Individual task display - Toggle completion checkbox - Delete button - Keyboard navigation support **Success Criteria:** - All configuration files are valid and complete (no comments in JSON) - npm install runs successfully - npm run dev starts the development server - Application renders without errors - All 7 requirements from PRD are implemented: 1. ✅ Task creation with validation 2. ✅ Task toggle 3. ✅ Task deletion 4. ✅ Filtering (All/Active/Completed) 5. ✅ Responsive Tailwind UI 6. ✅ TypeScript strict (no 'any') 7. ✅ Keyboard navigation - TypeScript compilation passes (tsc --noEmit) - No console errors in browser **Files to Create:** **Configuration Files:** - package.json - tsconfig.json - vite.config.ts - tailwind.config.js - postcss.config.js - index.html - .gitignore - README.md **Source Files:** - src/main.tsx - src/App.tsx - src/index.css - src/types/task.ts - src/components/TaskInput.tsx - src/components/TaskFilter.tsx - src/components/TaskList.tsx - src/components/TaskItem.tsx === END THINKING === ================================================================================ RESPONSE ================================================================================ I will implement a complete Simple Tasks application from scratch following the Design Document specifications. This is a new React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS project. **Implementation Strategy:** **Phase 1 - Project Setup:** Generate all configuration files (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, .gitignore, README.md) with correct dependencies and strict TypeScript settings. **Phase 2 - Application Code:** Create the complete component structure with App.tsx as the main container managing task state, and four child components (TaskInput, TaskFilter, TaskList, TaskItem) implementing all required features: task creation with validation, toggle completion, deletion, filtering (All/Active/Completed), responsive Tailwind UI, and keyboard navigation support. All code will use TypeScript strict mode (no 'any' types), follow the component architecture from the Design Document, and implement the 7 core requirements from the PRD. The application will be fully functional after running `npm install` and `npm run dev`.
